ICS 77.140.20MTD 19Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the requirements for seamless, welded and heavily cold worked welded stainlesssteel tubes of outside diameter less than or equal to 304.8 mm, for the food, beverage, dairy and pharmaceutical industry, requiring special surface finish.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
